description: This file defines a React component ExploreMindmapCanvas used for rendering an interactive mind map visualization specific to an exploration feature in a career navigator app. It includes types for nodes, edges, viewport, and rendering logic for nodes and edges, including layout calculations and user interactions such as panning, zooming, and node clicking.

methods.name: clamp
methods.description: Clamps a number between min and max values.

methods.name: wrapLabel
methods.description: Wraps a text label into multiple lines with specified max characters per line and max lines.

methods.name: computeRadialLayout
methods.description: Calculates radial positions for nodes based on their kind and title.
